title: Spectrum Analyzer Visualization
description: Add real-time spectrum visualization showing input/output frequency content and filter response curves per channel. See docs/plans/2026-01-06-spectrum-analyzer-design.md for full design.

title: Integrate spectrum analyzer into processor
description: Add SpectrumDataCollector instances to PluginProcessor. Feed input/output samples in processBlock().

title: Integrate spectrum analyzer into editor
description: Add SpectrumAnalyzer components to PluginEditor. Add global toggle button for showing/hiding tables. Update layout for graph-only and graph+table modes.

title: Measured filter response from input/output difference
description: Derive filter response from actual input/output spectrum difference instead of mathematical calculation. Shows real effect including non-linearities. Requires audio playing to display. Could overlay as subtle line alongside mathematical curve.

title: Implement SpectrumDataCollector class
description: Create ring buffers and FFT processing for capturing input/output audio samples per channel. Lock-free writes from audio thread, FFT computation on GUI thread.

title: Implement FilterResponseCalculator class
description: Create utility class to calculate combined frequency response from all 16 EQ bands using standard biquad magnitude formulas. Returns dB values at logarithmically-spaced frequencies.

title: Implement SpectrumAnalyzer UI component
description: Create JUCE Component that renders spectrum fills and filter curve with Dracula theme colors. Runs 30fps timer, applies exponential smoothing, caches filter response.

title: Initialize channels dynamically in prepareToPlay
description: Query getTotalNumInputChannels(), resize channel vectors, extract channel abbreviations from AudioChannelSet::getAbbreviatedChannelTypeName(). Initialize ChannelEQ and SpectrumDataCollector instances.

title: Test channel configuration changes mid-session
description: Verify behavior when host changes channel count during session. Settings should preserve by position - existing channels keep settings, new channels get defaults.
close_reason: Manual testing verified - multi-channel support working

title: Add channel visibility toggles to UI
description: Add row of checkbox toggles below spectrum analyzer. One toggle per active channel, colored to match channel's curve color. Clicking toggles visibility of that channel's filter curve.

title: Update filter table for channel selection
description: Modify table to display bands for selected channel only. Wire Import/Clear buttons to selected channel. Update table when dropdown selection changes.

title: Update processBlock for N-channel iteration
description: Replace hardcoded left/right processing with loop over all active channels. Iterate buffer.getNumChannels() and process each through corresponding ChannelEQ.

title: Modify SpectrumAnalyzer for multi-channel curves
description: Update SpectrumAnalyzer to accept multiple ChannelEQ references. Render multiple filter response curves with Dracula color palette. Add per-channel visibility flags. Remove input/output spectrum rendering.

title: Multi-channel support
description: Extend Room Multi EQ from stereo-only to support any channel configuration (mono, 5.1, 7.1, Atmos, etc.). See docs/plans/2026-01-06-multi-channel-support-design.md for full design.
close_reason: Epic complete - multi-channel support implemented and tested

title: Implement Dracula color palette for channels
description: Define color constants: Cyan #8be9fd, Green #50fa7b, Purple #bd93f9, Orange #ffb86c, Pink #ff79c6, Yellow #f1fa8c, Red #ff5555. Implement getChannelColor(int index) with cycling for 8+ channels.

title: Test mono and stereo configurations
description: Test plugin with mono (1 channel) and stereo (2 channel) hosts. Verify parameter persistence, UI updates correctly, audio processing works.
close_reason: Manual testing verified - multi-channel support working

title: Update isBusesLayoutSupported for flexible channel configs
description: Accept any bus layout where input and output channel sets match and are not disabled. Remove stereo-only restriction.

title: Add channel selector dropdown
description: Add ComboBox dropdown to select which channel's table is displayed. Format: abbreviation + full name (e.g. 'L - Front Left'). Update when channel configuration changes.

title: Test surround configurations (5.1, 7.1)
description: Test plugin with 5.1 (6 channel) and 7.1 (8 channel) configurations. Verify all channels accessible, colors distinct, UI handles many channels gracefully.
close_reason: Manual testing verified - multi-channel support working

title: Update parameter naming scheme for N channels
description: Change parameter IDs from left_/right_ prefix to ch{0-23}_ prefix. Pre-allocate parameters for 24 channels max (1921 total params). Update getParamID() helper.

title: Replace stereo channel members with vectors
description: Replace leftChannel/rightChannel ChannelEQ members with std::vector<std::unique_ptr<ChannelEQ>>. Same for SpectrumDataCollector. Add channelNames vector and numChannels tracking.

title: Update parameterChanged for new naming scheme
description: Parse channel index from ch{N}_ prefix instead of left_/right_. Route parameter changes to correct channel in vector.

title: Restructure PluginEditor for unified layout
description: Remove dual ChannelEQComponent instances. Add unified SpectrumAnalyzer at top, visibility toggles below, channel dropdown + Import/Clear buttons, then single filter table for selected channel. Update resized().
